chapter: Strange Encounter of the Tete Isle Kind
act_title: Strange Encounter of the Tete Isle Kind

quests.title: Strange Encounter of the Tete Isle Kind

dialogue.t: Thanks. But I'm busy, so please don't stand around here.

dialogue.sit: Whatever you're working on, I can help you.

dialogue.t: Fine. Then help me set up these targets. I'm a marksman, so I need to train.
It doesn't matter who I am.

dialogue.sit: You were a guest in the bar. We've met.

dialogue.t: Have we? Guess that's why you look familiar. I've met a lot of people today, so I don't really remember the faces... but that isn't important right now.
What's important is whether you've seen a bald-headed guy around here? I have something to talk to him about.

dialogue.sit: That sounds like the person I'm looking for.

dialogue.t: Oh, was he here just now? I guess he must have seen me coming...
Hmph. I'll get you for this, Icahua...
Since we've met before and you seem alright, I'll warn you to steer clear of that follicly deficient rascal and me — otherwise, that pretty face of yours might end up covered in red and white paint.
These are the things I found in his camp. I'm guessing he didn't have time to take them with him.
They're yours now. Don't worry, he's already forfeited any right to object.
Sooner or later, his life will be mine.

quests.description: You encounter a mysterious bald-headed figure in the wilderness of Tete Isle…
